{{Quote|We want a Quarren king!|The Quarren|<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>}}
This '''Quarren''' lived on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
Before the Battle of Mon Cala, this [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] along with others participated in the meeting between their [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in the [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari City]]. During the meeting, this Quarren and two others expressed their opinions regarding the choosing of a new king (after the previous king, [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]], was assassinated) which they believed should not be Mon Calamari prince [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], but a Quarren.
